summary: The image is a table titled 'Consolidated Financial Data - Second Quarter, Fiscal 2025' showing the comprehensive income statement for Infosys over three and six months ending September 30, 2024, and September 30, 2023. It details financial metrics such as revenues, cost of sales, gross profit, operating expenses, and net profit, with growth percentages year-over-year and quarter-over-quarter. Key insights include a 3.7% year-over-year revenue growth for the three months ending September 30, 2024, and a 2.9% growth for the six months. The operating profit margin slightly decreased by 0.1% year-over-year for the three-month period. Notable is the 16.7% increase in dividend per share over the six-month period.
